note: approverDid missing — an enrolment always names the one approver it binds.
approverDid is a did:web — a step-up approver is an Ed25519 did:key.
replaces is not a did:key — only an approver can be replaced.
subject in the payload — the subject is the document's issuer; a payload member naming another subject would let one subject enrol a factor for somebody else.

A signingKeyDid naming a console delegation to act for the subject — an enrolment is signed by the subject's own DID, never by a delegation, so there is no member through which one could be nominated (a delegation-signed document is refused as subjectMismatch).
statement as a string — it is a complete signed document, verified as received.
Response carrying the binding at the top level instead of under `approver`.
